extracted.summary: Tom is self-representing in a divorce and asks to borrow about £17,000 to instruct representation, with around £276,500 of assets (house and pension) in dispute.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for getting in touch with Lodestar Legal Finance about funding for your divorce. To take your enquiry further we would need a few more details: where the proceedings are taking place, the current stage and any upcoming hearing dates, and the name of any solicitor you intend to instruct. It would also help to have a breakdown of the assets in dispute and how they are held. Once we have that information a member of the team will review your enquiry and come back to you. Nothing in this message should be taken as an offer of funding or as legal advice.
